title: DC-area forecast: Downpours and storms possible into tonight. Nicer midweek.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: A few passing showers possible until 7 p.m. or so. Scattered downpours and storms are likely after 7 or 8 p.m. and into the night. One or two storms could produce damaging winds or a tornado.

What's next? A few afternoon thunderstorms are possible on Monday. Sunshine returns in full swing Tuesday and Wednesday and it's not as humid.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Scattered showers and storms increase this evening. An isolated storm could produce damaging winds or a tornado during the evening, while some pockets of heavy rain could threaten localized flooding into overnight. Some spots could end up with an inch or more of rain from today and tonight. Muggy lows near 70 to mid-70s. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow (Monday): A cold front lingering nearby keeps the chance of a few showers and gusty storms in play, starting mid-afternoon. Partly sunny skies help temperatures trend warmer with highs in the upper 80s to low 90s and with plenty of humidity lingering. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow night: A slight chance of lingering showers and storms into late evening, ending before midnight. Otherwise, skies trend partly to mostly clear with lows in the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: High

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Plenty of sunshine Tuesday and Wednesday. Highs reach the mid-80s to near 90 as humidity steps back a bit to the moderate range. Either day could work if you are trying to squeeze in a late-summer day poolside. Confidence: Medium-High

Mostly sunny Thursday and partly cloudy Friday. Highs both days in the 80s as humidity edges a bit higher. Even though the chance of a late-day shower or storm may return, both days should be decent enough to enjoy before summer starts to run out. Confidence: Low

Today’s daily digit — 4/10: Cloudy and humid with showers and storms. Cool temperatures well below average are a bit of a silver lining. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

DC weather history for August 16

Oppressive heat in 1997 sent temperatures to 102 degrees with a heat index of 111, kicking off a two-day stretch of extreme, record-setting conditions.
